To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
artificial ponds in southern Africa are valuable to local aquatic insect diversity.

artificial ponds have greatly increased the area of occupancy of lentic aquatic insect assemblage, especially dragonflies, but that natural still waters are still required to sustain all indigenous lentic species.

artificial ponds in southern Africa support a rich diversity of aquatic insects, especially in the arid regions where natural still waters are scarce, but that these ponds are not able to maintain the full diversity of aquatic insects in the region.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the conservation of aquatic insects in the context of the many artificial lentic habitats that have been created in the last 50 years, mostly for water supply.
the ecological value of artificial ponds for local aquatic insect biodiversity in southern Africa, especially during drought.
the value of novel ecosystems for biodiversity and ecosystem function.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the value of artificial water bodies for aquatic insects has been substantial, but not complete.
artificial ponds are of great value to aquatic insects, but that they are not a substitute or replacement for natural lentic aquatic ecosystems.
artificial ponds have greatly enhanced the diversity of aquatic insects and their habitats in southern Africa, and that this enhancement has been especially important in arid areas.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
artificial ponds have a substantial value for lentic aquatic insects, but that these are not a substitute to natural still waters.
artificial ponds are a boon for aquatic insects, and especially during droughts, and are a vital part of the aquatic insect fauna in southern Africa.
artificial water bodies, especially in drylands, are an important component of the aquatic ecosystem, but they are not a substitute to natural aquatic ecosystems.
